basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: AI Agent Engineer · Production Runtimes & Orchestration · Full-Stack · Founder
basics.summary: Engineer who ships production AI agents that move metrics, not demos. Built and deployed agent systems with LangChain, OpenAI, Claude, and Strands at LumApps and Beekeeper. 2x outbound conversions, $337K in vendor cost eliminated, 10M+ users served. Verification-first by instinct: at PulseView the rule is if the model cannot explain the signal, it does not ship. Founder-mode comfort moving backend to frontend to infra in the same day; 3 companies built on the side.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI agent program end-to-end: runtime, orchestration, integrations, and rollout. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Built and deployed production AI agents for outbound sales. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day across SDR and AE teams.

Designed the agent runtime and orchestration (LangChain, FastAPI, GCP) with integrations across Salesforce, email, and internal CRM tooling. Shipped directly to prod, reported to C-level on outcomes not progress.
Expanded scope to own company-wide AI governance and agent strategy: where agents are trusted to act, where humans verify, how outcomes get measured.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who operates like a founding engineer. Owns the problem, designs the solution, ships to prod, stays accountable to the metric. Built AI-powered products used by millions while growing the engineering team.
highlights: Built AI Onboarding Specialist that gives every new signup personalized, high-touch guidance at scale. 100% of customers guided through setup without adding headcount. Same shape as an AI coworker living inside the product surface.
Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an LLM pipeline built in 6 weeks (GitHub Actions + OpenAI). 12K+ assets translated, product team now iterates without external gatekeepers.
Built GenAI demo system for sales. Orchestrates content generation from Salesforce data so every pitch feels custom-built for that customer. Improved demo speed and close rates.
Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end. Became the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR). Designed for 99.99% SLA because customer trust is measured in uptime.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist and mentor for seed-to-VC stage startups. Evaluates technical architecture and advises on AI adoption and systems that scale.
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built everything from scratch: architecture, infrastructure, APIs, and the algorithms that made 500+ real-world deliveries possible.
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous delivery platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS) with real-time flight control APIs and logistics optimization. 500+ deliveries, 40% faster, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents.
Built cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipeline from scratch. Enterprise-grade reliability that enabled partnerships with Unilever and a CES showcase.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: AI research at the frontier of robotics. Built Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot morphologies and control systems via genetic algorithms. Foundational AI work that underpins my current agentic systems craft.
highlights: Engineered Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and brains via genetic algorithms. Morphology and neural control evolved together through artificial selection.
Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs impractical on local hardware. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Foundational AI experience (optimization, search, fitness landscapes, learning from environment) that informs how I approach modern LLM and agentic systems today.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: AI agents that generate AND justify trading signals using technical and news data. Core principle: if the model cannot explain the signal, it does not ship. Verification before output, every time.
highlights: Built the full stack solo: agent runtime, real-time market data integrations, signal generation and justification layer, web frontend.
Live retail users after self-validating on my own portfolio. Explainability as the product, not a feature.

projects.name: Proplab - AI Real Estate Tools
projects.description: Property inspections run on paper, clipboards, and WhatsApp photos. Built MVP for a fully digital, image-backed, timestamped inspection workflow that replaces the entire manual process.
highlights: Shipped MVP replacing paper-based inspection workflows with structured, image-backed, timestamped records.
Building AI marketing assistant that auto-generates property listings from inspection data. One workflow, zero copy-paste.

projects.name: SwissNRI - Cross-border Fintech Platform
projects.description: Swiss-Indian families navigating FEMA, DTAA, and Swiss regulations had zero digital help. Just spreadsheets and expensive advisors. Built the first platform addressing this.
highlights: Zero-to-MVP in 3 months. Compliance-first design: regulatory guardrails for both jurisdictions built before features.
Customer feedback loops drove 40% uplift in satisfaction. Roadmap owned by what users actually asked for.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: AI coworker in Slack and Teams that connects to a vast array of tools and carries out substantial operational duties across finance, ops, engineering, and GTM. Recently raised $75M led by Accel. Remote across Europe (Munich and Warsaw). Compensation $100K to $200K USD plus meaningful equity. Building the agent itself: runtime, memory, orchestration, verification loops, integrations, infra, and reliability at scale. Responsibilities: building agent runtimes (sandboxed execution, orchestration, memory systems); shipping integrations across APIs, OAuth, webhooks, and tool ecosystems; running infrastructure handling 600K+ tool calls per day; building systems where agents verify their own work instead of hallucinating success; shipping directly to production daily in a very small team. Looking for: experience building or significantly modifying AI agents; strong systems thinking; agentic coding as default workflow; engineers who can move from backend to frontend to infra without friction; genuine curiosity around how AI systems actually work.
_jobApplication.notes: Recruiter outreach via Laurence Brown (laurence.brown@jointechtree.uk). Company name not disclosed in pitch.
